Save at least 10% when buying a pack vs buying singles on downlights – 6 pack code 709RE.

The Saxby CosmosEco V3 is a fixed, fire-rated LED recessed downlight designed for reliable performance. This dimmable unit features an integrated LED, providing a crisp 500 lumens of cool white 4000K light with a wide 65-degree beam. It is suitable for both domestic and commercial installations, including bathroom zones due to its IP65 rating. Installation is straightforward for tradespeople, utilising a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block for fast wiring and requiring only a standard 57mm holesaw. Its robust steel body and 50,000-hour life ensure durability and long-term illumination for any indoor environment.
